data.fund_type: An open-ended scheme replicating / tracking Domestic Price of Silver
data.investment_objective: The Investment Objective of the Scheme is to generate returns that are in line with the performance of physical silver in domestic prices, subject to tracking error. However, there is no guarantee or assurance that the investment objective of the scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Silver and Silver related instruments with Silver as Underlying# : 95 to 100% (Very High) Money Market Instruments* including Tri-Party Repo on Government securities or Treasury bills, cash & cash equivalents : 0 to 5% (Low to Moderate)
data.benchmark: Domestic Price of Silver (based on LBMA Silver daily spot ﬁxing price)
